key_facts: The Pentagon's FY27 request totals $1.15 trillion in base budget spending and $350 billion in reconciliation spending.
The 'Reconciliation 3.0' resolution passed in the House contains only $60 billion for defense, well short of the requested $350 billion.
Golden Dome missile shield requested $17.1 billion in reconciliation dollars but only $400 million in the base budget.
RTX has signed 'framework' munitions deals for Tomahawk and AMRAAM that are not yet in its backlog or financial expectations.
The defense budget crossed $1 trillion for the first time in FY26 due to the 'One Big Beautiful Bill' adding $150 billion for the Pentagon.
